_comment: Copy to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ttrpg-transcriber/config.json (usually ~/.config/ttrpg-transcriber/config.json) and edit. Every key here is optional except 'vault', which has no default because there is no correct guess. Environment variables win over this file: GM_VAULT, GM_AUDIO_ROOT, GM_CHROMA_ROOT, GM_WORK_ROOT, GM_CAMPAIGNS_SUBDIR, GM_TRANSCRIPTS_SUBDIR. Run 'python3 campaign.py doctor' to see what resolved and where each value came from.
